admitted.nl: For this exact training pattern, recolor every row according to the nearest nonzero marker above it, with marker 2 producing a 2-block in columns 1-2, marker 1 a full row, and marker 3 a full row.
Interpret each colored seed as a horizontal ray: 1 and 3 fill their row, while 2 makes a width-two vertical stripe spanning all rows without a 1/3 barrier.
Use the first column/row seed sequence as instructions: alternating 2,1,2,1,3 create corresponding stripe/solid bands, and blanks inherit the 2 stripe.
Replace every row by the color of its nearest seed row: 1/3 become full-width horizontal bands, while 2 becomes a two-cell band at columns 1 and 2.
All zero rows are filled with a 2 domino at columns 1-2; every row containing 1 or 3 is flood-filled with that row's nonzero color, and 2 rows become dominoes.
The object is a cellular automaton whose stable output is exactly seven-row-periodic: colors 2 occupy a vertical domino stripe, and colors 1/3 occupy full horizontal lines at their seed levels.
